title: Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce
subtitle: Grilled chicken skewers with a rich peanut dipping sauce
excerpt: Strips of chicken thigh marinated in soy, honey, and turmeric then grilled or pan-fried and served with a quick peanut dipping sauce made from peanut butter, coconut milk, and lime. The peanut sauce takes five minutes and keeps in the fridge for three days.
sourceNotes: Based on the Indonesian and Malaysian street-food tradition of satay, cooked here in a frying pan rather than over charcoal.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Marinate the chicken up to 24 hours ahead. The peanut sauce keeps for 3 days in the fridge.

content.text: If using bamboo skewers, soak them in water for 30 minutes before threading the chicken so they do not scorch under the heat. The peanut sauce should be thick enough to coat a spoon; thin it with a splash of warm water if it becomes too stiff.

items.prepNote: cut into long strips for threading onto skewers
2 crushed cloves for the marinade, 1 crushed clove for the peanut sauce
1 juiced for the sauce, 1 cut into wedges to serve
peeled and grated, for the sauce

content.text: Mix the soy sauce, honey, turmeric, and 2 of the crushed garlic cloves in a bowl. Add the chicken strips and toss to coat. Marinate for at least 15 minutes.

Make the peanut sauce: whisk together the peanut butter, coconut milk, juice of 1 lime, the remaining crushed garlic clove, grated ginger, and chilli flakes. Thin with warm water if needed. Season with a little salt.
Thread the marinated chicken strips onto skewers in a loose weave.
Heat a frying pan over a high heat. Cook the skewers for 3 to 4 minutes per side until charred and cooked through.
Serve immediately with the peanut sauce and lime wedges.

items.symptom: Peanut sauce is too thick to dip
items.cause: Coconut milk reduced or peanut butter very stiff
items.fix: Stir in warm water a teaspoon at a time until pourable.

items.symptom: Chicken is sticking to the pan
items.cause: Pan not hot enough or moved too early
items.fix: Let each side cook undisturbed until it releases cleanly.
